name: docs
body: Author documentation (docs/): the repo's task-oriented author references linked from README.md — docs/templates.md (the template-author reference: library layout, `template.yaml` manifest fields, reserved context and names, layout helpers, themes and media), docs/layered-libraries.md (the two-layer how-to with a worked example and the cross-layer rules), and docs/cookbook.md (task recipes: footer via `.slide`, nested child/children, wrapper layouts, theme `media:`/`theme:<name>/` references). They document the format the code implements and are not template assets. Realised by the docs/ Markdown files.
